verdict.rationale: The public get-started tutorial walks through submitting an audio file to the Asynchronous Speech-to-Text API and retrieving the transcript, including a plaintext retrieval command. Webhooks can signal job completion, and the docs are machine-readable via llms.txt and .md pages, so an agent can follow the flow end to end without a human step. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the API-key auth step in the docs, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the flow.
